changes.before: Reuters' earlier report says Deutsche Bank flagged risks from Tesla's focus on robotaxis. [[n0957]] The newly accelerated affordability programme adds another element to that strategic assessment, without making the earlier uncertainty disappear. Reuters also reports the shift in low-cost cars leaving Mexico and India factory plans in limbo. [[n2168]] A disciplined investor needs to understand where the company is concentrating its effort and how the choices support expected returns. The optimistic case can allow for adaptation; the cautious case can ask whether repeated shifts make the investment path less predictable. Neither should assume that a promise about a broader opportunity settles every implementation question. A coherent strategy matters because a shareholder owns the consequences of the choices, not just the most exciting interpretation of each announcement.
